propositions: Twenty-one visible pure-intercept routes lack committed help artifacts and do not appear in overview help or respond correctly to `rebar help <command>`

Route registry and parser factories must be authoritative for command identity, grammar, and help; committed artifacts must serve identically through `rebar help <command>` and `rebar <command> --help`
Identity child parsers and certain nested handlers must support help via `--help` flags without executing command handlers or mounting ticket stores
Help discovery predicate must be exactly `not route.hidden and not route.retired` across all census sites; overview omit set must remain exactly `help`, `bridge-fsck`, and `bridge-probe`
Parser-owned descriptions must populate overview help for `reconcile.build`, `enrich.build`, `identity.build`, and `certs.build_trusted_env`; explicit multiline `trusted-env` usage must be preserved

Helper functions for usage unwrapping and metavar normalization must be consolidated in `gen_cli_help.py` and applied to intercept routes; `_render_intercept` must be removed and CLI reference generation must consume committed-byte artifacts
